prompt.project_info: Editorial luxury automotive lifestyle portrait inside a premium SUV.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved young adult man with styled wavy brown hair and short beard, calm confident expression, seated in the driver's seat wearing a black coat and black leather driving gloves; one gloved hand on the steering wheel and the other relaxed near the console.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 asymmetric medium portrait from the passenger side, face left-of-center, steering wheel and glove as secondary focal points, cream quilted leather interior, wood trim, panoramic roof, forest and sky visible outside.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright directional natural light from windows and roof, dramatic soft shadows, preserved highlights, sophisticated calm polished luxury mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic sharp digital photography, tack-sharp subject, medium depth of field, high-contrast black, pine-green, sky-blue, and warm-tan palette.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 3:4 photorealistic luxury automotive lifestyle portrait of one generic approved young adult man with wavy brown hair and short beard seated in a premium SUV, wearing a black coat and leather driving gloves, one hand on the steering wheel, cream quilted interior, wood trim, panoramic roof, forest landscape outside, bright natural directional light and refined shadows.
